strict_rule: A strict fixed-community conversion requires a pre-existing durable community machine identity plus a completed, independently useful Agent Guild action and a durable identity/result join. Expansion readiness additionally requires a current free anonymous operation whose own server consumes an exact AG artifact and exposes identity-bound result evidence. Listings, schemas, health, zero price alone, authentication refusals and caller-side validation do not qualify.

product_signal.platform_contract_signal: A marketplace can advertise a zero-price operation while its authoritative invocation still requires a payment security scheme and its only durable result-readback route is paid. Zero catalog price is not equivalent to free usable evidence.
product_signal.conservative_recommendation: Represent invocation price, admission credential, result delivery and durable receipt retrieval as four independent machine-readable gates. Do not mark an operation free-and-runnable unless all required evidence paths are also free and anonymous.
